title: New DATA_LAYER Error Code Added
summary: The `CrmlogErrorCode` schema in Google Cloud Integrations now includes a new `DATA_LAYER` enum value for `commonErrorCode`. This provides more specific error categorization for integration issues.
details: Developers can now use or expect the `DATA_LAYER` error code when dealing with `CrmlogErrorCode` objects. This new enum value, added to `schemas.CrmlogErrorCode.properties.commonErrorCode`, helps in identifying issues originating from the data layer within integrations, allowing for more granular error handling and logging.
